text: The outgoing server refactor makes nsIMsgOutgoingServer the common sending interface and keeps hostname, port, and client ID on nsISmtpServer. Code that needs SMTP-specific fields explicitly queries that interface. This prepares for EWS sending without assuming every outgoing server is SMTP.
title: Keep SMTP settings on the SMTP-specific interface
